name: Unbounded Relational Assertion (status >= 200)
description: Assertion checks 'status >= 200' without ceiling, so HTTP 500 error causes false pass.

failure_vector.code_snippet: def resp = client.send(); assert resp.statusCode >= 200; // Passes on 500!

expected_resolution.healed_code: def resp = client.send(); assert resp.statusCode >= 200 && resp.statusCode < 300;
